name: dsh-llm-retry-fixed
description: DSH host plugin: retry LLM quota-exhaustion failures (429 insufficient_quota / code QUOTA) on a fixed schedule — immediately, 1s, 5s, 10s, 30s, 1min, 2min, 5min, 10min — before giving up. Uses the same agent/request-error recovery extension point and durable llm/retry events as the stock exponential policy.
